RG-A003-P0.scope: Audit plan, rollback ledger, manifest generator, and probe workflow.

RG-A003-P1.scope: Generated probe artifacts and inventory evidence.
RG-A003-P1.rollback: Remove committed P1 evidence; retain failed workflow artifacts externally.

RG-A003-P2.scope: Bootstrap, integrity Service Worker, resolver, map, and historical Home enforcement changes.
RG-A003-P2.rollback: Restore all listed preimages and delete only the two new A-003 runtime files.

RG-A003-P3.scope: Final generated manifest and bootstrap manifest digest seal.
RG-A003-P3.rollback: Restore the P2 bootstrap pre-seal version and remove the final manifest.

RG-A003-P5.scope: Live Chromium tests and defect fixes discovered by the live matrix.
RG-A003-P5.rollback: Reverse only the failed P5 defect-fix commits in reverse order, then rerun the last passing earlier gate.

RG-A003-P6.scope: Final receipts, PR metadata, and stop-line updates.
RG-A003-P6.rollback: Restore pre-P6 audit metadata; do not change tested runtime bytes.

failed_evidence_policy: Retain failed manifests, workflow artifacts, browser logs, and diagnostics.
